text:
anya: Quick sync on compact rows: deciding between inline version-pin affordance vs. action toolbar when rows are selected. Also flagging metric badge density + contrast. Will paste two gifs shortly :camera_flash:
jason: Saw the gifs  inline pin is very discoverable on hover but it adds visual noise when many rows are shown. Toolbar keeps the rows clean.
mara: Filter ordering bug again: chips reorder after page refresh which breaks muscle memory. We should persist chip order in localStorage or user prefs.
devex: For keyboard users, toolbar is simpler. You can `Shift+Arrow` to select multiple rows, then Tab to the toolbar and press `L` to lock. If pin is inline, you'd need to focus every row to lock which is slow.
eli: a11y: current metric badge color fails for small text. Contrast test: #5F4BEE on white -> 3.9:1. Needs 4.5:1 for small text. Suggest either darker purple #301AA8 or make badge text 14px semibold. Also recommend `aria-label` on badge: "median 42ms, p95 130ms".
anya: UX tradeoff: inline pin = immediate affordance for single model workflows. toolbar = better for batch workflows. Which should be default for new users?
jason: Default to toolbar for discoverability + keyboard flows. Add a subtle affordance: when hovering a row show a ghost pin icon (non-interactive) to hint that locking exists. Clicking row selection still activates toolbar actions.
mara: Agree. Also add an option in the table view menu: "Show inline pins" for power users who prefer per-row controls.
storybook-bot: Uploaded stories: Compact/RowVariants/ToolbarLockHint (id: 210) and Compact/RowVariants/InlinePinOptIn (id: 211). Preview: https://stb.redwood.dev/storybook/compact-rows (210,211).
a11y-bot: Scan results: after suggested palette change (#301AA8) contrast = 4.7:1 for 12px normal. Add `aria-hidden` on decorative icons. Provide live region message: "Model <name> pinned to version <v>".
